evidence.detail: The class extends R115 ScriptPacketHandler and is registered as exact ScriptPacket ID 19.
It resolves R11 StatusTimerType values, finds matching StatusTimer instances in Client.u, updates remaining duration, removes expired entries and constructs new StatusTimer instances when absent.

Incoming names beginning with 'dyn_' are handled by the same class through a separate dynamic-timer path with packet-supplied text, image/metadata and duration.
